requirements.text: TemplateExp is a class that represents template expressions.
ObjectTemplateExp is a class that represents Object Template Expressions
A collection template expression has a collection kind.
An element of a model pattern.
A template expression can be bound to a variable
An object template expression may contain multiple property template items.
A collection template expression may contain any number of OCL expressions
A collection template expression may be matched to one OCL expression.
A property template item has exactly one Object Template Expression as its object container.
A property template item has exactly one property as its referred property.
